text: Good morning po! Naglilinis kasi kami ng bahay ngayong weekend, and I found several empty shampoo bottles, plastic water bottles, food containers, and old plastic pails in our storage area. Gusto sana naming ibenta yung mga puwede pang i-recycle instead of throwing everything away. Do you accept these kinds of plastic materials?

Hello! Our small store recently received a lot of new supplies, so we have many empty delivery boxes, cardboard cartons, paper bags, old newspapers, and used office papers piling up in the stockroom. Most of them are still dry and clean. I would like to know if your junkshop accepts these materials because we want to clear some space before the next delivery arrives.

Hi po, we had a family gathering last week, and after cleaning up, we collected a lot of empty soda cans, aluminum food trays, and some old aluminum kitchen utensils. Some cans are already crushed, while the others are still in their original shape. We have separated them from the plastic bottles and glass jars. Can we bring the aluminum items to your shop for recycling?

Good afternoon! May mga natira kaming materials pagkatapos ng renovation sa bahay. I found several rusty iron bars, old steel pipes, metal brackets, and a few copper wires from the electrical repair. Hindi ko pa alam kung magkano ang halaga ng mga ito, pero gusto ko munang malaman kung tinatanggap ninyo ang mga ganitong klase ng metal scrap bago ko dalhin lahat sa junkshop.

Hello po! We run a small food business, and we have accumulated many empty glass sauce jars, juice bottles, vinegar bottles, and glass containers from our products. We already removed the remaining food and washed most of them. May ilang bote na may labels pa, pero glass naman ang mismong lalagyan. Do you accept these for recycling, and should we separate them according to their size?

Hi, I was cleaning an old computer workstation and found several unused electronic items that no longer work properly. These include a damaged computer mouse, an old keyboard, broken phone chargers, earphones, a router, and a few circuit boards from an outdated desktop computer. Some accessories still turn on, but most are defective. I want to dispose of them responsibly instead of mixing them with ordinary household waste. Do you accept electronic waste?

Good morning po! Our family recently cleaned the garage, and we found several bags containing different recyclable materials. There are empty plastic detergent containers, plastic drinking bottles, old newspapers, used notebooks, flattened cardboard boxes, and aluminum soda cans. We have already placed the items in separate piles, but I am not sure whether your shop accepts all of them. Which of these materials can I bring for recycling?

Hello! We are clearing out a small repair shop that has not been used for several months. While sorting the storage area, we found empty glass jars, broken glass bottles, old steel brackets, copper wires, damaged chargers, and circuit boards from some electronic equipment. May mga gamit din na hindi na namin matukoy kung saan nanggaling, so those are separated for now. I mainly want to know if you accept the glass, metal scraps, and electronic parts.

Hi po! I am helping my parents organize our sari-sari store because we need more space for new products arriving next week. We spent almost the whole morning arranging shelves, cleaning the floor, and checking the remaining inventory. During the cleanup, we collected many empty cardboard product boxes, shipping cartons, plastic packaging, and large plastic containers. Some boxes have printed designs, while others are plain brown cardboard. We also found a few reusable bags, but I am not sure if those should be included. Can we sell the cardboard and plastic items at your junkshop?

Good afternoon! We recently moved some things out of our old storage room and discovered several sacks of items that have been sitting there for years. Some are containers, some are boxes, and others are small pieces of different shapes. I cannot remember where most of them came from, and I do not know what materials they are made of. A few items feel heavy, while others are lightweight, but I have not checked them carefully. I would like to bring everything to your shop and ask whether any of it can be recycled.

Good morning po! We cleaned our kitchen and found empty shampoo bottles, plastic water bottles, food containers, and old plastic pails in storage. Everything has been emptied and placed in separate sacks. Do you accept these plastic materials?

Our office is replacing its filing system, so we have bundles of old reports, used notebooks, envelopes, and newspapers. They have been kept indoors and are dry. Would your shop accept these paper materials for recycling?

May mga lumang kahon po kami mula sa delivery ng appliances noong nakaraang buwan. Na-flat na ang karamihan, pero may ilang malalaking karton pa. Gusto sana naming ibenta ang mga ito bago maglinis ng bodega.

Our small food stall has accumulated empty soft-drink cans and clean aluminum food trays after several events. Some cans are dented, while others are intact. Can we bring these aluminum items to your junkshop?

Naglinis kami ng likod ng talyer at may nakita kaming lumang bakal na tubo, kalawangin na rehas, at ilang pirasong steel frame. Hindi na ito ginagamit at gusto naming malaman kung puwede itong ibenta bilang scrap metal.

We are sorting jars from a small homemade jam business. The containers are glass jars with their metal lids removed, plus a few clear glass bottles that previously held juice. Are these accepted for recycling?

I found a box of obsolete computer parts while clearing the school laboratory storage room. It contains broken keyboards, old computer mice, a damaged router, and several power adapters. We want to dispose of these electronic items responsibly.
May mga plastik na galon at timba kaming naipon sa bahay. Ginamit dati ang mga ito sa tubig at panlinis, pero nahugasan na at wala nang laman. Tumatanggap po ba kayo ng ganitong plastic?

The neighborhood association held a cleanup, and I collected old magazines, school worksheets, paper folders, and discarded flyers. We separated the dry paper from food waste. Can these paper items be sold by weight?
Boss, may mga kahon ng sapatos at karton ng mga bagong paninda sa tindahan. Nakatupi na sila at nakatali sa magkakahiwalay na bundle para madaling ikarga. Bumibili po ba kayo ng cardboard?

After a birthday party, we collected many empty aluminum drink cans and placed them in a clean sack. There are no glass bottles in this batch, just cans. Would you be able to buy these aluminum items?
May mga lumang pako, bakal na bracket, at sirang steel shelf po kami mula sa pag-aayos ng bodega. Pinaghiwalay namin ang mga ito sa ibang basura. Puwede po ba itong dalhin bilang scrap metal?

Our family has a box of glass sauce bottles, pickle jars, and clear beverage bottles. Most labels have been removed, and the glass is kept apart from other recyclables. Do you accept this type of glass?

I am clearing a drawer of outdated accessories and found broken earphones, two damaged phone chargers, and a small circuit board from an old device. None of these works anymore. Are these considered electronic waste?
May mga supot, plastic food tubs, at bote ng shampoo po kaming gustong ibenta. Galing ang mga ito sa maliit naming salon at tindahan, at nilinis muna namin bago ilagay sa sako.

The school library is replacing old materials, leaving stacks of outdated newspapers, printed worksheets, and used notebook pages. They are all paper and have been stored in a dry room. Do you accept them?

We received several shipments for our online shop and saved all the large brown corrugated boxes. Some have tape on them, but they are otherwise dry and flattened. Does your junkshop buy cardboard cartons?

May pinaglumaan po kaming aluminum kaldero, lumang kawali na aluminum, at ilang lata ng soft drinks. Hindi na ginagamit ang mga ito at gusto naming malaman kung may halaga pa bilang recyclable aluminum.
A contractor left behind metal offcuts after repairing our gate. We have iron rods, steel brackets, and a short metal pipe in one container. Can these be sold as other metal scrap?

Hello, we are cleaning a small café storeroom and found empty glass syrup bottles, coffee jars, and a few glass beverage containers. They are separated from the plastic packaging. Are glass containers accepted?
Boss, may lumang CPU parts po kami, sirang keyboard, at mga charger na hindi na gumagana. Galing ito sa computer shop na nagsara. Tumatanggap po ba kayo ng electronic waste?

I am organizing our laundry area and found empty detergent bottles, fabric-softener containers, plastic spray bottles, and two old plastic laundry baskets. We have no use for them now. Can I bring these plastics for recycling?
May mga lumang resibo, papel na pang-print, at diyaryo po kaming nakatabi sa opisina. Nasa kahon ang mga ito at hindi nabasa. Maaari po bang ibenta ang mga papel na ito?

Our warehouse has a pile of cardboard sleeves, shipping cartons, and product boxes from deliveries. We remove the plastic wrap separately and keep the cardboard dry. Does your shop purchase these by kilogram?
I have a bag of crushed aluminum cans and several clean aluminum trays from a food stall. They were collected over the past month and are ready to be weighed. Are you accepting aluminum scrap?
May mga bakal na kadena, lumang turnilyo, at sirang metal hinges po mula sa pagkukumpuni ng pinto. Nakaipon na sila sa garahe. Puwede ba silang dalhin sa junkshop bilang scrap metal?

We are emptying a pantry and found dozens of glass jars that once held sauces, jam, and pickles. The jars are empty, and we have placed them in sturdy crates so they will not break during transport. Do you accept glass jars?

A relative gave us an old desktop computer to dispose of, and we found a damaged motherboard, a broken mouse, and several computer cables in the same box. We do not plan to repair them. Would you take these electronic parts?

Good afternoon po. Nagpalit kami ng mga lalagyan sa tindahan kaya marami kaming lumang plastic bottles, gallon containers, at food tubs. Naka-separate na sila at wala nang laman. Tumatanggap po ba kayo?

The community center recently cleared a cabinet and produced stacks of used paper forms, old calendars, notebooks, and folded newspapers. Everything is dry and free from food residue. Can these paper items be recycled?

May mga karton po mula sa refrigerator delivery at kahon ng electric fan. Malalaki ang mga ito pero tinanggal na ang styrofoam at pinatag ang karton. Bibilhin po ba ninyo ang ganitong cardboard boxes?
Our food stall keeps a separate container for empty aluminum beverage cans. It is now full, and we also have clean aluminum foil trays from catering orders. I would like to know if both are accepted.
I am clearing a workshop shelf and found steel wire, rusty iron pieces, and a broken metal rack. These are ordinary metal scraps from repairs, not electronic equipment. Can I sell them to your shop?

May mga bote at garapong salamin po kaming galing sa paggawa ng suka at chili oil. Naubos na ang laman at nilinis na namin ang mga ito. Gusto sana naming malaman kung tinatanggap ninyo ang glass containers.

We upgraded the internet equipment at our small office and now have several unusable modems, a broken network router, old chargers, and a damaged power strip. Should we bring these as electronic waste?

I collected plastic shampoo bottles, empty dishwashing-liquid containers, and a cracked plastic storage bin from our apartment cleanup. I rinsed them out and placed them together in a sack. Does your junkshop buy this kind of plastic?

Sa classroom po namin, naglinis kami ng cabinets at may mga lumang activity sheets, scratch paper, notebook pages, at diyaryo. Inayos namin sa isang kahon para hindi mahalo sa ibang basura. Puwede po ba itong ibenta?

Our printing shop has a stack of cardboard packaging from paper reams and toner deliveries. The boxes are clean, folded, and stored away from rain. We want to know if they qualify as recyclable cardboard.
May mga lata po ng soft drinks, aluminum trays, at lumang aluminum na takip mula sa kusina. Pinagsama namin ang mga ito dahil pare-pareho silang aluminum. Tumatanggap po ba kayo ng ganito?
During a home repair, we replaced a steel handrail and removed several iron brackets and metal hinges. They are in a bucket in the garage. Can those pieces be accepted as scrap metal?

Our restaurant has saved glass bottles from sauces and beverages for several weeks. We removed the caps and rinsed the bottles, then placed them in a separate crate. Are these glass recyclables suitable for your shop?

May sirang printer po kami, lumang keyboard, at ilang charger na hindi na gumagana. Nasa stockroom lang ang mga ito mula noong nag-upgrade kami ng computers. Maaari po ba itong dalhin bilang electronic waste?

We are cleaning a rental house before the next tenants arrive. There are empty plastic water bottles, old plastic pails, food storage containers, and broken plastic hangers. Can we sell these plastic items instead of discarding them?

May mga lumang papel mula sa accounting office: printed invoices, scratch paper, envelopes, at mga lumang diyaryo. Nakatali na ang mga bundle at hindi naman nabasa. Bumibili po ba kayo ng paper waste?

Our delivery area has accumulated sturdy cardboard boxes from rice sacks, canned goods, and household supplies. We flattened the boxes and removed loose plastic wrapping. Would your shop accept the cardboard?

A school event left us with a large bag of empty aluminum cans and a few disposable aluminum serving trays. The items are separated from other waste and ready to be weighed. Can these be sold for recycling?
May natira pong metal scrap mula sa pagawaan: steel rods, bakal na tubo, at sirang metal stand. Hindi na ito magagamit sa repair, kaya gusto sana naming dalhin sa junkshop.

We have a collection of empty glass medicine jars, jam jars, and beverage bottles from a community kitchen. The glass containers are separated from the lids and stored carefully. Do you accept this type of glass for recycling?

An old electronics drawer contained a broken tablet, damaged headphones, a dead power bank, and several tangled charging cables. We want to dispose of them properly and would like to know if your junkshop takes electronic waste.
May mga plastic na timba, galon, at bote ng panlinis po kami sa bahay. Nakaipon na sila nang ilang buwan at kailangan nang alisin sa storage area. Puwede po ba silang ibenta sa inyo?
